svg.title: Pulsus Dash — AWS region eu-west-1 in 3D: request path from the edge to data (City view, INC-2041)
svg.desc: Perspective 3D City view (⌥3) of AWS account prod-payments, region eu-west-1, at ladder level L1 with the Health layer on and the Network layer partially on. The scene reads front to back along the request path. On the outside-the-estate ring at the front left, the CloudFront distribution shop-cdn is an edge arch gate (1.8k requests/s, cache hit 91 %, 5xx 0.4 %) with edge-location posts LHR, FRA and CDG, a Route 53 hosted-zone marker shop.example.com, and the AWS WAF web ACL as a thin shield wall in front of the gate (1.2k blocked per minute); a dashed origin arc leads to the S3 vault assets. On the regional plateau, vpc prod (10.20.0.0/16) is a glass enclosure with three AZ terraces eu-west-1a, b and c, each with a solid-edged public subnet tile and dashed private-app and private-data tiles. The internet gateway is a gate in the enclosure front wall and one NAT gateway sits in each public subnet. The ALB alb-checkout is a wide arch spanning the three public subnets with one segment per AZ (a 3/3 neutral, b 2/4 and c 2/3 Degraded), listener HTTPS :443 to target group checkout with 7 of 10 healthy targets and target 5xx 4.1 %; arcs run only to healthy replica blocks. The EKS cluster prod-eu-1 (EKS 1.31) is a district over the private-app tiles with managed node groups ng-general (m7i.2xlarge ×18) and ng-memory (r7i ×6) as blocks of buildings, a ghost pair of buildings for two nodes being provisioned, a control-plane hall managed by the provider (API p99 180 ms), and workload towers: checkout banded by revision 41 to 42 at rollout 6/10 with three Degraded blocks, payments and catalog. A smaller internal ALB is Healthy. Aurora pg-orders spans the three private-data terraces as three dimmed cylinders. Outside the enclosure on the plateau stand the DynamoDB tables as managed cylinders filled by consumed capacity, reached through a VPC gateway endpoint gate in the enclosure's right wall: orders in Watch with 120 write throttles per minute and p99 18 ms, sessions and inventory OK, with a global-table bridge leaving the plateau towards us-east-1; the SQS ribbon orders-queue lies behind the enclosure. The whole request path internet, CloudFront, internet gateway, ALB, checkout, endpoint, orders is lit with particles. The probable origin psp-api is an external ring marker at the far edge reached by a Failing egress arc via the NAT gateway. A hairline dashed fence marks the account. Top: region strip with counts and INC-2041 (checkout Degraded since 12:22, 12:19 timeout config change, about €38k/h at risk) and a T hint to the 2D architecture diagram. Right: docked 2D panel for alb-checkout with request and target-5xx lanes, healthy targets per AZ, target response time p95 and the per-hop path list. Bottom left: legend mapping shapes to AWS services. Six numbered callouts explain the grammar.
